title: Home page: sort by recency buckets
description: Add a day or week bucket option to the references include, for example select=recent bucket=week. The newest bucket comes first, and within a bucket the shared human-rating ordering applies. Bucket on the date that selection already orders by (accepted time for recent). State the time zone in the docs and settings. A rating never moves a Reference to another bucket. Configurable by site, with the ledger rules unchanged. Same sort available for the Story listing include once Stories have stars.
